global_changes: Original question and lookup-query text is byte-for-byte preserved per case.
V1 fact groups become mandatory semantic obligations with stable obligation IDs distinct from lookup IDs and source-verified alternate witnesses; matching remains formatting-only.
Public source path_or_url and response estimated_tokens replace evaluator-only path and output_tokens fields.
Authority and scope are derived from the active catalog for real responses; explicit values are accepted only in marked synthetic fixtures.
Real source identity includes active explicit documents and supported files recursively discovered under active catalog roots; root-derived identity does not adjudicate relevance.

Realistic unsupported-answer controls require safety, identity, budget, and no-authorization gates for both insufficient-evidence and retrieval-only payloads; retrieval-only context must explicitly deny answer support, availability, and edit readiness.

Lookup and query-original retrieval attribution never establish completeness; evaluator semantic completeness is compared only with an explicit internal diagnostics.component_coverage claim, otherwise the runtime claim is unavailable.
Accepted semantic witnesses require a nonempty unique returned evidence_id, exact accepted source, and substantive non-heading snippet.
No v1 thresholds carry into v2; both lanes are report-only and reused v1 paraphrases are EXPOSED_PARAPHRASES_REPORT_ONLY, not an independent holdout.
